title: Unified Token-Efficient DSL Syntax Across All Technologies
description: Unify syntax across all DSLs in the repo (dsl/ engine, mathematical/graph/dsl wire+Jack, vcs .ops header, trinity/ram legacy lexer, ~55 adopter crates). Target: maximum token/parser efficiency (schema stated once via SoA tables, implicit-preferred, bare strings), domain-intuitive syntax subsetting existing languages (SVG paths, Cypher), streaming/lazy-loadable layout (metadata first, statement-level incremental parse), and one consistent sigil set repo-wide: `:` typing, lowercase-kebab names, PascalCase domain kinds / UPPERCASE schema type tags, `--`/`->`/`<-` connections, `@` connection points, `_` placeholders, bare-preferred `""` strings. Compose's C# expression language is explicitly deferred to a follow-up ticket. Full design in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-dsl-must-be-crispy-shell.md — Wave 0 engine (dsl/core, dsl/schema, dsl/derive, dsl facade, delete dsl/codec), Wave 1 choke points (vcs .ops, mathematical/graph/dsl wire+Jack), Wave 2 parallel adopter packages (P1-P10 covering all fixture-bearing crates), Wave 3 convergence gate (delete serde_json::Value DocumentDsl bridge, full verify).
summary:
Unified syntax across all DSLs in the repo via a 4-wave, 14-agent rollout (full plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-dsl-must-be-crispy-shell.md). One law now applies everywhere: ':' typing, lowercase-kebab names, PascalCase domain kinds, '--'/'->'/'<-' connections, '@' connection points, '_' placeholders, bare-preferred '""' strings, SoA tables instead of repeated-key AoS lists, metadata-first canonical layout.

Wave 0 (engine, dsl_core/dsl_schema/dsl_derive/dsl facade): added BackArrow('<-')/Placeholder('_') tokens and is_bare_ident; deleted Shape::Ident/FieldValue::Ident (Shape::Text now bare-prints); deleted Shape::RawLines and the forgiving whole-doc lexer, split parse into parse_tokens; added Shape::Table (SoA, header-once, positional rows, AoS still accepted on parse, canonicalize migrates to SoA); finalized Shape::Wire with '<-' normalization; fixed print_record field ordering and the "key= value" spacing bug via Writer::glue(); replaced the identity to_kebab_or_camel with a real to_kebab; added #[dsl(table)]; deleted the zero-consumer dsl_codec crate. 210 engine tests green (dsl+dsl_core+dsl_schema+vcs+mathematical_graph_dsl).

Wave 1 (choke points, parallel): vcs's .ops header re-derived on the engine as a real DslOps enum (no more '@doc' sigil clash, no more percent-escape, real lists instead of comma+percent-encoding). mathematical/graph/dsl's wire module now delegates to dsl_schema (unified '--'/'->'/'<-', '{k=v}' double-quoted); Jack's lexer replaced with dsl_core::lex (dual-quote input, double-quote print), With/Unwind/Call added to its AST as prep for Architect.

Wave 2 (10 parallel adopter packages, P1-P10): all ~55 #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)] adopter crates swept (kebab #[dsl(key)] cleanup, #[dsl(table)] adoption, dsl::Wire adoption for edges) and every example fixture hand-regenerated to the unified syntax via parse->print->write-then-delete-temp-test. draw's path segments are now a genuine SVG-path-data subset (M/L/Q/C/A/Z). Compose's Architect query language now parses through Jack instead of its own nom parser (with documented grammar-coverage trade-offs — Jack lacks multi-hop chains/property-map literals/AS aliasing/ORDER BY/LIMIT/CALL YIELD, so Architect fixtures were re-expressed in Jack's actual grammar rather than extending shared Jack). trinity/ram fully migrated its runtime port keys from 'nodeId:portId' to 'nodeId@portId' (dag/s/node-graph deliberately left on the old format as a 3-way atomic follow-up — spawned task_785776df). JSON-bridge stragglers converted to typed fixtures: forms, gis/2d, lowpoly, s (demo.s), dag (demo.dag).

Wave 3 (convergence gate): deleted 'impl DocumentDsl for serde_json::Value' from vcs as a structural gate; exactly 3 stragglers broke (compose's KitSnapshot, and puzzle's three PlayApps which got local Value-bridge newtypes per the existing, separately-scoped puzzle-plugin architecture) and were fixed. Zero DocumentDsl-related build errors remain repo-wide; full cargo build --workspace has unrelated red crates from two other concurrently-open sessions (a UI ChromePalette refactor and ticket PACK-BINARY-DOCUMENT-LAYER-ACROSS-ALL-APPS's DocumentPack rollout), confirmed via mtimes/grep to be zero-overlap with this work. Hand-reviewed 5 regenerated fixtures end to end; zero leftover temp-regen tests or new [DEBUG] logs; zero new files outside this ticket's own scratch folder.

Deferred/out of scope per plan: compose's C# expression language (own ticket, per explicit user decision). Flagged as follow-up background tasks: dsl_schema's Shape::Table has two real bugs (nested table-in-table row desync; duplicate-same-type-DslRecord-column corruption) discovered and worked around by multiple packages — task_6a2ed75c. The nodeId:portId -> nodeId@portId migration for dag/s/node-graph — task_785776df. trinity/plugin's two local port-key helpers still hardcode ':' after trinity_ram's '@' migration — task_11e64f5b (spawned mid-rollout by the P5 agent).
